description: Create filled regions covering rooms in a view (e.g. to colour/mark rooms), optionally clearing previously created markers and setting colour and transparency.

clearExisting.description: Remove previously created room filled regions (matched by marker) before creating new ones.

filledRegionTypeName.description: Name of the FilledRegionType to use.

marker.description: Marker/comment tag written onto created filled regions so they can be cleared later.

roomIds.description: Optional explicit Room ElementId list. When omitted, rooms in the view are used.

viewId.description: Target view ElementId. Defaults to the active view when omitted.
